name: v11-c-retention-from-start
note: V11-C (PLAN.md amendment 1): retention from the start. From round 54 (not C2), with round 54's optimizer state as C2 was trained, one run whose curriculum holds C2's and R1's grammar v2 examples together (5 new examples of each of the 350 programs: C2's 3 plus R1's 2) and the 50% replay share of round 54's own production mix drawn by forgetting score from the first step (B's weights, /home/user/lmwork/v11/forgetting_1302.json; data seed 1302 so the weights match the production round). One epoch of the training split (steps = training-split tokens / 4096, measured by a dry run before launch), lr 1e-4 WSD to 1e-5, top 24 layers, fp32, seed 1301. Hypothesis: the loss happens while C2 is trained, so the examples C2 forgot, present from round 54's first step, prevent it; restoring it from C2 afterwards failed five times.
